name: Asserufen Schafkopf
description: Asserufen Schafkopf (Ace-calling Schafkopf) is a four-player variant of PfÃ¤lzer Schafkopf. The game announcer calls an ace of a suit to choose a partner; the holder of that ace is the teammate but stays hidden until playing the called ace. In calling games hearts (Herz) is trump. Uses French-suited cards. Caller leads; when the called suit is led, the holder must play the called ace if possible (Unten Raus). Solo options also exist.
